svg.title: The JKY Terminal installer
svg.desc: One line pasted into a terminal installs JKY Terminal: the JKY logo, a system check, the download with a progress bar and checksum, the shortcut picker answered with the arrow keys, and Installation complete — launch with jky.

text.tspan: T E R M I N A L

g.text: Installing JKY Terminal — AI terminal. Infinite possibilities.

text.tspan: JKY Terminal runs on macOS, Linux and Windows.
Choose a global summon shortcut for JKY Terminal
↑↓ choose · Enter confirm · 1-3 pick · c type · Esc skip

g.text: It opens JKY Terminal from anywhere on your system.
Your choice is saved in JKY, so you are only asked once.

text.tspan: Ctrl + Alt + J — registered with GNOME
in any terminal to open it.
